about: IsoKron's own fixture servers for the writecheck loop worker (loop/run-items.mjs). A subject listed here (only IsoKron's own npm packages, maintained by the isokron-ai npm account) installs with npm ci from its committed lockfile in `lock`, whose entry for the package must carry the sha512 `integrity` given here, and runs with its dogfood manifest (the same file, byte for byte, that the dogfood workflow runs) instead of the generic catalog manifest. The manifest is written at /work/m/x/writecheck.yaml and `link` points its relative cwd at the installed package, so the plan is the same as the dogfood one. Where full.plan_hash is set, the full write test runs against a disposable backend inside the sandbox; full.plan_hash is the hash a person read and accepted in dogfood-tiny-tracker.yml or dogfood-kronicle-lite.yml for the same server version, manifest and CLI. A plan that gives another hash is recorded as drift and the full run does not start. known_answer names the tiny-tracker defect the shard's known-answer control switches on. Change only by a reviewed commit. A fixture with install_scripts installs in the sandbox's build image (node24-build) with the sandbox's native build env: its native modules (kronicle-lite's better-sqlite3) compile from source against the image's own Node headers, and the install reaches registry.npmjs.org only.

kronicle-lite.subject: isokron-ai/kronicle-lite
setup:
set -e; mkdir -p /work/out/kl-data /work/out/kl-seed; printf '# Dogfood guard

This store belongs to one CI job and is thrown away after it.
' > /work/out/kl-seed/guard.md; printf '# Bystander one

Not created by the tester.
' > /work/out/kl-seed/by1.md; printf '# Bystander two

Also not created by the tester.
' > /work/out/kl-seed/by2.md; node "$1/dist/cli.js" put dogfood-guard /work/out/kl-seed/guard.md --title 'dogfood guard'; node "$1/dist/cli.js" put dogfood-bystander-1 /work/out/kl-seed/by1.md --title 'bystander one'; node "$1/dist/cli.js" put dogfood-bystander-2 /work/out/kl-seed/by2.md --title 'bystander two'
